set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, cover fixation_entropy for fixation groups, density, eye_density and multiscale inputs plus Ops.eye_density. Enumerate density versus grid, duration weighting, log base, normalization and scale aggregation. Measure addition, subtraction, multiplication and division semantics. Exit with independent finite-grid entropy and arithmetic cases, signed-mass rejection tests, explicit aggregation weights and portable conformance fixtures.
set.title: Pin entropy and map-arithmetic conformance
